fields.hook: No day counter to a first client. No price-going-up card. A typed note from Jared.
fields.body:
Operators Workshop is an AI community run by three people who run businesses.
There is no first-client countdown here and no deadline.
What we share is the prompts, systems, wins and mistakes behind the work.
Some of it works. Some of it we throw out. You see both.
If you want an income plan, this is not it.
